# arin_rdap_help (Data Source)

Read ARIN RDAP service metadata, including conformance identifiers, advertised reverse-search properties and complete help JSON. No API key is sent. Advertised capabilities do not guarantee that every query is supported; individual requests remain authoritative.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
data "arin_rdap_help" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `conformance` (List of String) conformance returned by ARIN.
- `rdap_json` (String) Complete RDAP help JSON, preserving notices, contact details, links and extensions. Links are not followed.
- `reverse_search_properties` (Attributes List) reverse search properties returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reverse_search_properties))

<a id="nestedatt--reverse_search_properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reverse_search_properties`

Read-Only:

- `property` (String) property returned by ARIN.
- `related_resource_type` (String) related resource type returned by ARIN.
- `resource_type` (String) resource type returned by ARIN.
